Menu.Title: Wrathmaker Rules
Menu.Name: Wrathmaker rules
Menu.Label: Configure Rules
Menu.Hint: Configure material tiers, their effects, and the custom flanking rule.

Editor.Intro: Materials can target one or more PF2e item types and grant separate effects. Tiers control prepared item names, prices, rarity, weapon attacks, and armor AC. The flanking section controls additional multi-side AC penalties beyond PF2e's normal Off-guard rule.
Editor.Hint: The configuration is validated before it is saved. Wrathmaker leaves ordinary two-sided flanking to PF2e, then uses untyped adjustments to reach the configured three- and four-side totals.
